description: We are team "1 braincell, 2 people", participating virtually in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 at the Harohalli local event. Our challenge was to harmonize historical satellite data (MODIS and VIIRS) to create a seamless record of global wildfire activity. To solve this, we built a web application featuring a burning activity calendar and anomaly charts, designed to help emergency responders and scientists easily analyze historical fire patterns and better understand fire trends over time.
